D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Mark DeSaulnier leads by 53.0 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 140,022 votes; a one point swing is about 1,321 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +46.5 and D +58.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.

D.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 0.3 points toward Mark DeSaulnier. Bank it: chase the remaining mail ballots and low propensity voters who have not voted.
